title: Fast and Slow Pointers: Pattern recognition and reusable templates

scenes.title: Mental model
bullets: Move two traversals at different speeds so their relative motion reveals cycles, midpoints, or phase boundaries.

scenes.title: State contract
bullets: Both pointers follow the same deterministic next relation; only their speed or restart position differs.

scenes.title: Worked reasoning
bullets: After slow and fast meet in a cycle, reset one pointer to head and move both one step to find the entry.
